card.name: Opening parenthesis before 'see' cross-references
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis at the end of a sentence clause in a drug label, right before a cross-reference such as 'see WARNINGS' or 'see PRECAUTIONS'.

modes.label: Cross-reference bracket
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a statement about interactions, contraindications or special populations, where a pointer to another label section follows.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write 'see' (and its Chinese and Japanese equivalents) as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label says '(see another section)' to point the reader elsewhere.
